verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents user-controllable retention policies, deletion guarantees, or data lifecycle settings. The only deletion-related item is API hub's metadata sync performing "orphan deletes", which is catalog reconciliation, not user data retention control. Generic CLI, API and IAM access controls are adjacent building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
